title: Serve with one gathered awareness
summary: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One.
source.lifeApplication: Before seva, gather the mind and lower the self.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes true when love is gathered toward the One.
evidence.turn: Ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, pause and refuse to grant ego the status of truth.
